##### Project general facts

Symbolic Altus by Symbolic Real Estate is an architectural statement, designed to embody modern living and urban harmony. The building's refined façade and clean geometry complement landscaped surroundings, offering residents a serene environment within one of Dubai's most connected communities. Balancing elegance and functionality, Altus represents a lifestyle where design, comfort, and simplicity flow together, creating a home crafted for those who appreciate balance and beauty.

The amenities at Symbolic Altus elevate daily life with resort-style leisure and wellbeing. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool, a fully equipped gym, a sauna and steam room, a yoga area, a kids' play zone, landscaped gardens, and a rooftop lounge. Supported by concierge services, valet parking, and round-the-clock security, the residence blends privacy, comfort, and convenience — embodying the essence of contemporary Dubai living.

Every residence at Symbolic Altus is planned with precision and grace, featuring open layouts, expansive windows, and refined finishes that fill every space with light and calm. The interiors feature branded fixtures, smart-home automation, and contemporary materials that merge functionality with subtle luxury. One and two-bedroom apartments are designed to capture the essence of sophisticated living, with modern finishing, high-quality materials, and fully equipped kitchens.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Liwan, a dynamic and well-integrated residential community in the heart of Dubai, this exceptional location offers a harmonious blend of modern living, convenience, and tranquility. The community is characterized by thoughtfully planned infrastructure, spacious landscaped parks, and pedestrian-friendly pathways, promoting a sense of connectivity and community engagement.

The location is distinguished by its central positioning and easy access to major road networks, making commuting and exploring the city effortless. The presence of schools, mosques, retail centers, and recreational spaces within the community emphasizes its self-sustained nature, offering residents everything they need right at their doorstep.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern elegance, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Liwan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of tranquil parks, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — serene, connected and effortlessly refined.
